body:
Do pluralization rules work for other values outside of relative time formatting? For example does.

``` php
echo __n('{0} month', '{0} months', $months, $months);
```

behave as you would expect given the Russian pluralization rules?

`__n()` will only work correctly if your locale/po file have the right plural rules header. What version of libicu do you have installed? `php -i | grep ICU` will tell you which version of libicu php is linked against.

> $ php -i | grep ICU
> ICU version => 49.1.2
> ICU Data version => 49.1.2
> MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
Ok. I have libicu v 54. I'll see if I can reproduce the issue with `__n()` as a starting point.
